title: JAD remote entry
description: <remotes folder>/<name>.json: another JAD server this one may call with profile_message, subagent, profile (info only), transcript and transcripts. The file name (without .json) is the remote's name, written remote:<name>/... in a tool call. It holds no model, tools or instructions, and never the token itself. A remote is reached over plain http or a unix socket: the bearer token travels in clear text over http, so put that connection behind a VPN or use a unix socket. There is no TLS and no proxy.

url.description: http://host[:port] or unix:///absolute/path.sock. https is refused. No path, query, fragment or credentials. The token of an http url travels in clear text.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable, which must start with JAD_REMOTE_ (a remote file cannot read provider keys or other variables), that holds the bearer token (at least 32 printable characters). Set exactly one of token_env and token_file.

token_file.description: File that holds the token, relative to this file or absolute. On unix it must not be readable by group or others.

max_response_bytes.description: Largest response body accepted; a larger one is an error, never a cut. Default 1048576.

retries.description: Retries of a request that failed to connect or got a 5xx (a send repeats with the same request id, so the remote never starts it twice). Default 2.

max_in_flight.description: Most requests to this remote at the same time. Default 8.

poll_ms.description: Longest one status poll of a remote run waits on the remote. Default 20000.

lost_after_ms.description: How long a remote run may be unreachable before its handle becomes lost. Default 60000.

default_session.description: Session on the remote used when a target is written remote:<name>/<category>/<name>.

profiles.description: Globs of category/name (no [classes]; '*' does not cross '/') that narrow what a model here may reach on this remote (never widens the remote token's own rights).
